name: The Jade Rabbit

frame.name: The Fate of All Fools
frame.description: Chain precision shots or land precision final blows to refill the magazine, improve stability, and greatly increase the damage of Firefly and body shots. Landing a body shot will remove one stack of the damage bonus.

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.description:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: High-Caliber Rounds
perks.description:
Shots from this weapon knock the target back farther.
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.description: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

flavor: "What kind of harebrained scheme have you got in mind this time?"
